meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: Claude 会按 git 专家方式工作:先判断请求是提交、rebase/squash 还是历史查找,再分析仓库最近 30 条提交的语言和风格,把改动按目录和关注点拆成多个原子提交,提交信息沿用仓库习惯;历史查找会使用 blame、bisect、log -S。
howto.when: SKILL 规定任何 git 操作都要用它;典型触发是你说“commit”“rebase”“squash”等关键词,或问“谁写的”“什么时候加的”“找引入这个改动的提交”这类历史问题。

say.text: 帮我把这些改动按目录拆成多个提交,信息沿用仓库风格。
say.note: Claude 会先输出风格检测和提交计划再执行。

say.text: 把最近几个提交 rebase 压缩合并,并处理冲突。
say.note: 会进入 REBASE 模式,检查分支状态后重写历史。

say.text: 查一下这行是谁写的,在哪个提交里加的。
say.note: 进入历史查找模式,用 blame 和 log 定位改动。

howto.what_en: Claude classifies the request as commit, rebase/squash, or history lookup. It studies the last 30 commit messages for language and style, splits changes into atomic commits by directory and concern, and uses blame, bisect, and log -S for history searches.
howto.when_en: It should trigger on any git operation, typically when you say "commit", "rebase", or "squash", or ask who wrote something, when something was added, or which commit introduced a change.

say_en.text: Split these changes into commits by directory, matching repo style.
say_en.note: Claude prints a style report and commit plan first.

say_en.text: Rebase and squash my recent commits, handling conflicts.
say_en.note: Enters REBASE mode, checks branch state, then rewrites history.

say_en.text: Who wrote this line and which commit added it?
say_en.note: Runs history lookup using blame and log.
